name: Bloody Buddy Survive
source:
In Bloody Buddy Survive, You'll have to survive to the two kidnappers, Aya and Ryo, that brought you down their basements by playing and winning their games.

This game is mostly based around shitposts and jokes to cover the stressful reality of being kidnapped, a fear you probably already felt once in your life.

[from [url=https://arcusnoel.itch.io/bloody-buddy-survive]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《Bloody Buddy Survive》中，你必须在两个绑匪Aya和Ryo的面前生存下来，他们通过玩并赢得他们的游戏将你带入他们的地下室。

这款游戏主要以垃圾帖和笑话为基础，以掩盖被绑架的压力现实，这种恐惧你可能已经在生活中感受到过一次。

[来自[url=https://arcusnoel.itch.io/bloody-buddy-survive]itch.io[/url]]
